summary: Local coverage of Purqazi is thin: district-level complaints dominate (unpaid sugarcane dues, irrigation power, stagnant cane prices, overloaded cane trucks), and the only Purkazi-town items found are a 2019 ODF Plus status and a 2019 demand to recognise Suliwala Bagh as a martyrs' site.
identity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Purqazi_Assembly_constituency (Constituency No. 13, Purqazi, district Muzaffarnagar, reservation SC, Bijnor Lok Sabha; the AC includes the Purqazi Nagar Panchayat in Muzaffarnagar tehsil)

positives.english: In Purkazi, open defecation is not seen and community toilets are fine
positives.hindi: पुरकाजी में खुले में शौच नहीं दिखता, सामुदायिक शौचालय ठीक हैं
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (Meerut bureau, 23 Feb 2019), verified: Purkazi nagar panchayat declared ODF Plus in the central sanitation survey; a Quality Council of Delhi team inspected on 16 January and found no open defecation; community toilet arrangements were better. Dated 2019, so may be stale.

positives.english: * Being on the Delhi-Dehradun highway (NH 58) makes travel to Delhi and Haridwar easier
positives.hindi: * दिल्ली-देहरादून हाईवे (NH 58) पर होने से दिल्ली और हरिद्वार आना-जाना आसान है
positives.basis: Inference: Wikipedia (Purkazi), verified, states the town is on NH 58, the Delhi-Dehradun highway, and shares a border with Haridwar district. No voter statement or appreciation found for this AC; this is a guess about what voters value.

positives.english: * Sugarcane is the main crop here
positives.hindi: * गन्ना यहाँ की मुख्य फसल है
positives.basis: Inference: Tribune (1 Mar 2021, Muzaffarnagar district-level), verified, describes sugarcane as the main grievance of farmers and gives per-hectare cost figures. It does not say sugarcane is the main crop of Purkazi or that it is a positive. Placeholder needing a field check.

positives.english: * Being close to Haridwar gives local farmers and traders access to a wider market
positives.hindi: * हरिद्वार से नज़दीकी से किसानों और व्यापारियों को बड़ा बाज़ार मिलता है
positives.basis: Inference: Wikipedia (Purkazi), verified, states the town borders Haridwar district in Uttarakhand. No source found on market access or voter views of it. Placeholder needing a field check.

positives.english: * Essential facilities in the town are running reasonably well
positives.hindi: * कस्बे में ज़रूरी सुविधाएं ठीक-ठाक चल रही हैं
positives.basis: Inference: the only Purkazi-specific source found (Amar Ujala 2019, verified) covers sanitation only. No source on current water, roads or power in the town was found in about 10 searches. Weak placeholder that must be checked in the field.

negatives.english: Sugar mills have not cleared last season's cane dues, and farmers are left waiting
negatives.hindi: चीनी मिलों ने पिछले सीज़न का बकाया नहीं चुकाया, किसान इंतज़ार में
negatives.basis: Tribune (dateline Muzaffarnagar, 28 Feb; published 1 Mar 2021), verified, district-level: farmers say several sugar mills have not cleared last season's dues; one farmer cited a delay of over a year. The article does not name Purkazi. Dated 2021; no newer Purkazi-specific source found.

negatives.english: The Makhiyali power house is overloaded, so irrigation power comes late
negatives.hindi: मखियाली पावर हाउस पर लोड बहुत, सिंचाई की बिजली देर से आती है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (video report, 20 Mar 2025, Muzaffarnagar district panchayat hall, Kisan Diwas), verified: farmers said the Makhiyali power house has been overloaded for three years, so irrigation power comes late. District-level. Makhiyali is not among the AC areas listed on the Purqazi AC Wikipedia page, so AC membership is unconfirmed; field check needed.

negatives.english: Cane prices have not risen for several seasons while farming costs keep rising
negatives.hindi: कई सीज़न से गन्ने का भाव नहीं बढ़ा, खेती का खर्च बढ़ रहा है
negatives.basis: Tribune (1 Mar 2021), verified, Muzaffarnagar district-level: a farmer says cane prices have not been raised for several seasons; FRP rose from Rs 255 (2017-18) to Rs 285 (2020-21) per quintal; a farmer spends more than Rs 2 lakh per hectare per season. Not Purkazi-specific.

negatives.english: Residents want Purkazi's Suliwala Bagh, site of 1857 killings, declared a national martyrs' site
negatives.hindi: पुरकाजी का सूली वाला बाग राष्ट्रीय शहीद स्थल घोषित हो, यही मांग है
negatives.basis: Wikipedia (Purkazi), verified: 'The citizens of Purkazi are demanding Suliwala Bagh to be declared as a National Shaheed Sthal'; the page describes the 1857 killing of 500 freedom fighters there. The page cites a Hindi headline dated 26 Jan 2019 attributing the demand to BKU. Town-specific, but a 2019 demand and not a service grievance; current status not found, so it may be stale and weak for vote impact. Replaces the 2021 Tribune fertiliser/cattle item, which was not Purkazi-specific and whose Hindi was too long.

negatives.english: Overloaded sugarcane trucks cause accidents, and farmers blame officials for them
negatives.hindi: ओवरलोड गन्ने की गाड़ियों से हादसे, किसान अफ़सरों को दोषी मानते हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (video report, 20 Mar 2025, Muzaffarnagar district panchayat hall), verified: farmers blamed officials for accidents involving overloaded sugarcane vehicles; the Additional DM promised to resolve the problem. District-level; no Purkazi road or accident is named.

notes: Identity confirmed via the Purqazi AC Wikipedia page: Constituency No. 13, spelled Purqazi, district Muzaffarnagar, SC, Bijnor Lok Sabha; the AC includes the Purqazi Nagar Panchayat (Muzaffarnagar tehsil). The ECI site was not checked. Round 2 verification: all 10 original source entries were opened and checked against their claims (4 unique URLs: Amar Ujala 2019, Wikipedia Purkazi, Tribune 2021, Amar Ujala 2025 video); all supported the stated facts, so none were removed. Negative 4 was replaced with a Purkazi-town item (Suliwala Bagh demand, 2019); the fertiliser/cattle item was dropped because it was district-level, dated, and its Hindi ran to 17 words. Negative 2 Hindi was shortened and negative 1 and 5 Hindi trimmed to 12 words. Only 1 of 5 negatives is AC/town-specific (Suliwala Bagh, 2019), so the 3-of-5 target was NOT met. Purkazi-specific 2024-2026 issues were searched (about 10 searches in Hindi and English covering nagar panchayat news, water, power, drainage, flooding, roads, NH-58 jams, sugar dues, Makhiyali power house) and none were found. Negatives 1, 3 and 5 rely on district-level sources, and negative 1 and 3 are from 2021. Positives 2-5 remain inferences: no voter source exists for them. Ganga khadar flooding was not found; a 2025 Amar Ujala report on Muzaffarnagar district flooding (3 Sep 2025) was seen in search results but does not name Purkazi and was not used. Field checks needed: Purkazi nagar panchayat water supply, drainage and garbage; NH 58 traffic and accidents at Purkazi; whether Makhiyali power house is inside Purqazi AC; current cane dues from the Purkazi-area sugar mill; Ganga or canal flooding; current status of the Suliwala Bagh demand. Vote figures were not used, as the brief excludes electoral data. P3 weak positive: sugarcane as main crop is a geography-style inference; no source shows voters value it. P4 weak positive: Haridwar market access is an unverified inference. P5 weak positive: no source on current town services. N4 is a 2019 heritage demand rather than a service grievance; kept as a resident demand, weak for vote impact.

round2.changes: Verified all 10 source entries (4 unique URLs) and confirmed the AC identity on the Purqazi AC Wikipedia page. Replaced negative 4 (district-level fertiliser/cattle, Tribune 2021) with the Purkazi Suliwala Bagh martyrs'-site demand (Wikipedia Purkazi, 2019). Shortened negative Hindi lines 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 to 10-13 words. Corrected negative 5 English to match its source (no claim that officials stop trucks). Corrected positive 3 basis to say the Tribune does not state sugarcane is Purkazi's main crop. Re-ranked negatives: dues, irrigation power, cane prices, Suliwala Bagh, overloaded trucks. Kept 4 inference positives flagged with *.
